5. **Security:** The society has engaged two security guards on a 24-hour rotation basis. The security agency charges Rs. 18,000 per month. The agency has provided a new guard in place of the one who left in February 2023.

The Chairperson informed the members that the term of the Managing Committee would expire on 31st March 2024. As per the bye-laws, elections were to be held before that date. The members were informed that the election process would be initiated in January 2024 and the results would be declared at a special general body meeting.

Joshi (Flat A-101), suggested the installation of a rainwater harvesting system in the society premises to address the water shortage during summer months. The Managing Committee noted the suggestion and decided to obtain quotations from authorised vendors. The matter would be placed before the next Managing Committee meeting for further consideration.

2. **Solar Panels:** A member, Mr. R. Nair (Flat C-201), proposed the installation of solar panels on the terrace to reduce the electricity bill of the society. The Managing Committee stated that a feasibility study would be conducted, and the matter would be discussed in the next Annual General Meeting.

3. **Intercom System:** A member, Mrs. P. Kulkarni (Flat B-101), complained that the intercom system in the building was not working properly since the last month. The Secretary assured that the matter would be taken up with the service provider and the system would be repaired at the earliest.

4. **Visitor Parking:** A member, Mr. S. Deshmukh (Flat D-401), requested the Managing Committee to look into the issue of visitor parking, as visitors often parked in the resident parking area. The Managing Committee decided to issue a circular to all members and security staff regarding the parking rules and to display a notice board in the parking area.

5. **Common Area Cleanliness:** A member, Mrs. A. Kulkarni (Flat C-102), raised the issue of cleanliness of the common areas, particularly the staircase and the lift lobby. The Managing Committee noted the concern and instructed the housekeeping staff to pay more attention to these areas. The Secretary was requested to conduct a periodic inspection of the common areas.

6. **Water Tank Cleaning:** A member, Mr. D. Patil (Flat B-201), asked about the schedule for the cleaning of the water tanks. The Secretary informed that the water tanks were cleaned on a quarterly basis, and the next cleaning was scheduled for the month of July 2023. The members were requested to inform the society office if they noticed any contamination or odour in the water.
